steps.en: Install the skill into your agent
steps.zh: 把 skill 装进你的 agent

steps.en: Hand it a finished Chinese draft; keep any style guide for the author in the same folder
steps.zh: 把写完的中文稿交给它；作者风格文档放在同一目录

steps.en: Locks headings, paragraph order, lists, tables and code blocks; reads the style guide first
steps.zh: 锁定标题、段落顺序、列表、表格和代码块，先读风格文档

steps.en: Edits only spans that hit one of the 11 numbered rules, and only as much as the hit needs
steps.zh: 只改命中 11 条编号规则的地方，改动只到解决问题为止

steps.en: Runs its acceptance checklist and returns the full text, with no change log unless asked
steps.zh: 按验收清单复查后交回全文，不附改动说明，问了才讲

value.en: Measured AI tells are gone while every unmatched sentence, number and hedge stays word for word
value.zh: 实测站得住的 AI 痕迹被去掉，没命中的句子、数字和限定词逐字保留

sources: https://github.com/larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-less-ai-tone README.en.md §4.1 — install `npx skills add larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-less-ai-tone`; submitting text applies the rule set; SKILL.md usable as a system prompt

https://github.com/larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-less-ai-tone SKILL.md — 有风格参考时先读它 (style document in the same directory wins on conflict); 硬性边界 whitelist + structure lock; 用法 steps 1–4; 不需要解释改了什么，用户问时再说明; 最终验收 checklist; rules 1–11
